verdict.rationale: INPI's homepage advertises public databases for "quick and targeted searches" (docs-12), which plausibly let a founder look up filings, but the evidence never says that application or case status is shown there. The probe found data.inpi.fr returns HTTP 403 to keyless requests and needs an account-issued token, so open lookup could not be confirmed hands-on. missing for 10: explicit documentation that public pages show filing/application/case status, coverage across trademark/patent/design filings, hands-on confirmation that status lookup works without an account.
